0022600002.text: Both the Philadelphia 76ers and New York Knicks open their 2026-27 seasons when the 76ers visit New York. Ariel Hukporti is out for Philadelphia with a ruptured Achilles, while Adem Bona (foot sprain) and Anfernee Simons (hamstring) are day-to-day and game-time decisions, and New York's Josh Hart is also day-to-day with ankle soreness and a game-time decision. The teams split their 2025-26 season series 2-2, but the 76ers lost 0-4 to the Knicks in the 2025-26 playoffs, most recently 144-114 in Philadelphia on May 10, and ESPN's matchup predictor gives the 76ers a 45% chance to win.
